egm.note: required=true for product and for modules needing upfront design. patch always skipped. status: skipped|pending|in_review|findings|resolved|blocked. Implementation blocked while blockingOpen is true.

verificationEvidence.note: Significant UI: set visualStatus (visually_verified|functionally_verified_visually_unverified|partial|blocked|changes_requested). visually_verified requires real on-disk artifacts + method render|manual — never static-only or fabricated paths. Patch/none may leave null. Guard -Validators …,visual.

context.note: If updatedAt is older than staleAfterHours, re-check scope/decisions/components before trusting. Never drop approval or security constraints as stale.

approval.note: Captain must explicitly approve; agents must not self-approve. EGM/Goldfish completion does not grant approval. Handoffs do not grant new approval. Bind via Get-ApprovalFingerprints.ps1 before done|accepted.

notes: Durable truth stays in PRD/REQUIREMENTS/DESIGN/DECISIONS/EGM_REVIEW. This file is the active slice + lightweight task memory. Before done|accepted run bootstrap/guard/Invoke-CompletionGate.ps1 (task-state+completion+approval + auto plugs); refuse while ok=false — see docs/sdlc/GUARD_BYPASS_MATRIX.md. Stamp approval.specFingerprint/scopeFingerprint with bootstrap/guard/Get-ApprovalFingerprints.ps1 (-WriteToTask). evidence shape is validated by bootstrap/guard (required non-empty commands or artifacts when status/phase is done|accepted). For multi-behaviour repairs, fill regression (inventory → baseline_locked → unit_check) and invoke Guard with -Validators task-state,regression. For recovery, set recovery.active=true and invoke Guard with -Validators task-state,recovery (keep attempts[] cumulative; do not reset attemptCount on new chat). For routing: classify attributes → Evaluate-Routing.ps1 → record invoked/evidence → Guard -Validators …,routing. Patch-minimal attrs unless non-trivial. For research: when unfamiliar/complex or researchNeeded, invoke skills/engineering-research, set research.required=true with findings+sources (alternatives required), Guard -Validators …,research. Routine copy patches skip. For significant UI: fill verificationEvidence.visualStatus honestly; Guard -Validators …,visual before done; static analysis alone ≠ visually_verified. VER-003: Critical/High unresolved security defects are not risk-acceptable as passed.
